review.reviewBody:
I had my eye exam at Academy. Dr. G was very thorough, friendly and knowledgeable.
The staff was very helpful and friendly as well. The office is modern and well stocked with a large supply of frames. Thank you for a great experience I’ll be returning for all my future optical needs.

Everyone was professional and friendly. Grateful for the in depth tools they use to check eye health (an eye scan vs the puff of air for glaucoma test). The optometrist was friendly and patient with my questions explaining everything along the way. I  also appreciated how the staff helped me pick out frames that fit my needs including taking pictures I could share with a friend for agreement on the best pair for me.
Top notch! Great doctor and staff! We felt extremely important and very well cared for.

Everyone in the office are great. A very friendly office. Very helpful. The doctor is great love him. Don't mind going to the eye doctor at all because of them. When you really need to see him they tried to fit you in right away which is great.
Very informative office, I felt comfortable the moment I walked in for my initial appt. And I was in and out in less than 30 mins. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a new eye doctor
Dr G was amazing along with the office staff

Ive been going to Academy Vision for over 20 years, I wouldn’t trust my eyes to anyone else.  Dr Ullman is caring, honest and always answers all of my questions.  His practice is so well run, everyone is so helpful and thorough.

. Dr Mark Ullman is very caring and very thorough.
The staff is caring as well. Everyone is very friendly and they make you feel comfortable. I would Def recommend him to friends and family... *****

My visit at Academy Vision was awesome the technician was so sweet and knowledgeable highly recommended I give her a 10+ and the doctor was very professional and concerned asking many important questions about my eyes issues I recommend anyone with eye problems or just a check up give them call and the staff was great it was a fun experience.
Fantastic staff and office!
From when you first walked in they were incredibly kind and personal. The Dr was so sweet and was willing to explain everything and anything! So glad my husband and I found them!

Jess at the desk is always the glue that holds it all together. She’s always kind, polite, and “on it”. The new doctor I got to see was very nice, seemed knowledgeable, and was a positive experience. I also for the first time purchased a pair of glasses from academy. The optometrist was super nice, thorough, and the price honestly was cheaper than my usually place (Costco), so I am very happy!
Excellent service and eye care!

I have been going to academy vision for about 6 years and I love it here I have yet to have a bad experience. The front staff is always so kind and helpful, The office is very clean, and the doctors are great! Dr. Marc Ullman is very personable but is also very professional and thorough when explaining things about your glasses, eye exam, etc. He’s the best ! I’ve been to other eye doctors at the office when he’s not available and they always have done a good job as well. The glasses selection is one of the best I’ve ever seen I’m super picky and have a hard time finding frames I like. And if you’re on the fence about going here I will say my favorite thing about this place is they don’t do that evil puff eye test they have a machine that takes picture scans of your eyes to check for glaucoma etc instead and it’s way better and more comfortable.

It was a pleasure being seen by Dr. Giollombardo
From the moment I walked in, the staff was friendly and efficient, making the whole process smooth and stress-free. Dr. G was professional and has great bed-side manner, I really felt like he took the time to listen and cater to what I needed, rather than sell me some generic junk You can tell he genuinely cares about his patients and their eye health. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a knowledgeable and personable optometrist!
First class operation. Great staff , friendly and happy to help. And Doctor Ullman is the BEST !!!!
I absolutely am 100% satisfied with Dr Ulman & the staff
The staff is amazing!  Very professional, helpful and friendly.   Dr. Ullman is the best. Always on top of eye care.  Would not go anywhere else@

Just had a visit March 16 I had a prob in my one eye called academy vision and they were able to get me right in ! Met with Dr giallombardo and he was great ! Knew exactly what I needed to do and put me at ease . And showed exceptional care . Prescribed an eye drop same day and I’m already treating my eye . And he will see me again in one week ! I would highly recommend this place , staff was friendly and easy to deal with . I give it ten stars  if i could . Thanks Dr G

Kind, professional staff. Bright, clean office. Impressive new technology/equipment with a great selection of glasses. Patient, knowledgeable doctor. Couldn't ask for a better experience! Highly recommend!
